author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear looks at the new McLaren 788HS supercar, a rival for the Ferrari 296 Speciale. It’s the Final Boss of McLaren’s 700-series range after the 720S, 750S and 765LT, and if its HS predecessors are anything to go by, it’ll be like a mini W1 without all the hybrid gubbins!

🚗 McLaren 788HS
